items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: Brewster’s Millions with Richard Pryor, going back to the 80s.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Oh movies like The Mae West Story and PeeWee’s Big Top Adventure or whatever that was, and a lot of movies like that we see live bands. Brewster’s Millions with Richard Pryor, going back to the 80s. They did a lot more of that then. But most of the time we’d get there very early and pre-record ourself. And then we’d just play to our own tracks. Because they don’t want that sound while people are giving dialogue.
Right. They want to have some control.
